query: The review bot left six comments on PR #412 and it's been sitting there all morning — deal with them.
note: Bot review threads on an open agent PR: apply-or-counter, then resolve.

query: All my PRs are green but none of them are merging. Nothing's red.
note: The classic symptom of unresolved review threads blocking auto-merge — check threads FIRST.

query: Start the pr-comments lane on a 5 minute loop.
note: Named invocation of the watcher lane this skill backs.

query: Should I turn on auto-merge for #388 yet, or wait for the review bot to weigh in?
note: The arm/disarm gate — this lane owns the initial arm-after-bot-review.

query: The bot posted a review comment AFTER the PR was already queued to merge. What now?
note: The late-thread-on-an-armed-PR race: disable-auto, fix, resolve, re-arm.

query: A reviewer says my null check is wrong but I think they misread the code. How do I handle that thread?
note: Wrong/out-of-scope feedback gets a reasoned counter, verified — not performative agreement.

query: Can I mark the review thread resolved now? The fix is committed locally.
note: Strict ordering rule: push first, confirm pushed, THEN resolve. Never resolve an unpushed fix.

query: Sweep the open PRs and close out any outstanding reviewer feedback so they can land.
note: Describes the lane's per-tick job without naming it.

query: gh pr view --json reviewThreads is coming back empty but I can see comments in the UI.
note: The known trap — use raw GraphQL for review threads.

query: The typecheck job is red on PR #412 — fix it.
note: A failing required check is the pr-checks lane, not review threads.

query: PR #388 got kicked out of the merge queue and lost its auto-merge. Re-arm it.
note: Re-arm-after-ejection is explicitly the pr-checks lane's, not this one — the load-bearing boundary.

query: That PR merged an hour ago but the linked issue is still open.
note: Post-merge close-out is the cleanup lane.

query: This spec fails maybe one run in six, then passes on retry.
Our merge queue takes 50 minutes to drain. Make it faster.
Write me a code review of this diff — what's wrong with it?
note: Performing a review is not the same as closing out review threads on an open PR.

query: Which model should the sub-agent on issue #142 run at?
My branch has a merge conflict against main.
note: DIRTY/conflicted branches belong to the checks lane.

query: Post a comment on the issue explaining why we're deprioritizing it.
note: Commenting on an issue is not resolving PR review threads.
